name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
summary: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, providing health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals.
eligibility: Bottom 40% vulnerable and poor families identified based on deprivation and occupational criteria from the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011). Also expanded to cover all senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year. Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses, diagnostic tests, and medications. No cap on family size or age.
application_process: Eligible citizens can check status at beneficiaries.nha.gov.in or visit any empaneled hospital / Ayushman Mitra kiosk with Aadhaar card or Ration card to generate their Ayushman Card.
key_facts: Portable across India: Beneficiaries can receive cashless treatment at any empaneled hospital nationwide.
Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one.
